mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM import_batch WHERE store_id = #{storeId} AND active_initial_inventory = 1

SELECT barcode, id AS product_id FROM product WHERE barcode IN
#{barcode}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO import_batch (store_id, import_type, data_date, file_name, file_hash, status, total_rows, success_rows, error_rows, error_message, posted_at) VALUES (#{storeId}, #{importType}, #{dataDate}, #{fileName}, #{fileHash}, #{status}, #{totalRows}, #{successRows}, #{errorRows}, #{errorMessage}, #{postedAt})

INSERT INTO import_raw_row (batch_id, `row_number`, barcode, raw_data, parse_status, error_message) VALUES
(#{batchId}, #{row.rowNumber}, #{row.barcode}, CAST(#{row.rawData} AS JSON), #{row.parseStatus}, #{row.errorMessage})

INSERT INTO store_product_inventory (store_id, product_id, warehouse_id, current_quantity, version) VALUES
(#{storeId}, #{row.productId}, #{warehouseId}, #{row.quantity}, 1)
AS new ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE current_quantity = store_product_inventory.current_quantity + new.current_quantity, version = store_product_inventory.version + 1

INSERT INTO inventory_movement (store_id, product_id, batch_id, business_date, movement_type, quantity_change, balance_before, balance_after) VALUES
(#{storeId}, #{row.productId}, #{batchId}, #{businessDate}, 'INITIAL_BALANCE', #{row.quantityChange}, #{row.balanceBefore}, #{row.balanceAfter})
